description: Python pipeline that regenerates, with one command (python run_all.py), every number, table and figure of the article "Support, Resolution and Segmentation Effects on Micro-CT Estimates of Porosity, Specific Surface and Box-Counting Dimension in Carbonate Rocks" (Mathematical Geosciences, submitted) from the micro-CT images of an Indiana Limestone (Calcite-1) and a Silurian Dolomite (Dolomite-3) (Ferreira et al., doi:10.17612/V09Y-AW80). Validated by 39 tests on synthetic volumes and series with known answers. The full reconstructions are not redistributed; the cropped stacks analysed in the article are archived in the companion data record.
